standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the cycle class of the spectrum of the base field with one.

standard_prerequisites.name: Multiplicativity of the degree map for products
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the degree map of a product is the product of the degree maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Relates the degree map of the square of the base field to the square of the degree map of the base field.

core_obligations: Identify the class (proof lines 4997-5001): the cycle class of the spectrum of the base field is one by the construction of the cycle class map.

Compute the degree (proof lines 5001-5010): the degree zero cohomology of the base field is the coefficient field and its square is the tensor square, so the map from the axiom defining the degree must send one to one because the degree map of the square of the base field is the product of the degree map of the base field with itself.
proof_roadmap: Use that the cycle class of the base field is one.
Apply multiplicativity of the degree map for the square of the base field to compute the degree.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the degree of the unit of the spectrum of the base field is one (statement lines 4993-4995). The proof (proof lines 4996-5010) uses that the cycle class of the base field is one and the multiplicativity of the degree map for products. H2: a complete short computation.
